'''Krood''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. After a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] flown by a group of [[Believers]] crashed in the Undercity, a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were pursuing it arrived shortly afterward and Krood&mdash;along with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ilok]], the [[Coruscani ogre]] [[Bartle]] and the Trandoshans [[Dure]] and [[Sounac]]&mdash;was among the group who attacked them.
